intro.text: A number sign (#) is used with this entry because of evidence that arthrogryposis multiplex congenita-9 with immunodeficiency (AMC9) is caused by homozygous mutation in the SENP7 gene (612846) on chromosome 3q12.3.

checks.claim: Arthrogryposis multiplex congenita-9 with immunodeficiency (AMC9) is caused by homozygous mutation in the SENP7 gene.
checks.evidence_quote: Exome sequencing identified a homozygous stop gain variant in SENP7 c.1474C>T; p.(Gln492*) as the probable aetiology.
checks.explanation: The paper reports a homozygous SENP7 variant as the probable cause of the arthrogryposis syndrome. Using the OMIM disease name is standard nomenclature.

checks.claim: The SENP7 gene is located on chromosome 3q12.3.
checks.evidence_quote: Exome sequencing identified a homozygous stop gain variant in SENP7 c.1474C>T; p.(Gln492*) as the probable aetiology.
checks.explanation: The chromosomal location is standard nomenclature that adds to the paper's mention of the gene. The abstract does not give the location itself.

paragraphs.text: Arthrogryposis multiplex congenita-9 with immunodeficiency (AMC9) is an autosomal recessive disorder. Its features include congenital arthrogryposis, neurodevelopmental abnormalities with failure to reach developmental milestones, early respiratory failure, and immunodeficiency with neutropenia, hypogammaglobulinemia, and recurrent infections. Affected individuals have died in infancy or in utero (Samra et al., 2023; Kobayashi et al., 2024; Saad et al., 2025; Pal et al., 2025).

checks.claim: AMC9 is an autosomal recessive disorder.
checks.evidence_quote: identified rare, biallelic, specifically homozygous, loss of function variants in SENP7 in 4 children from 3 unrelated families
checks.explanation: Biallelic homozygous variants found in several unrelated families point to autosomal recessive inheritance.

checks.claim: AMC9 features include congenital arthrogryposis.
checks.evidence_quote: presenting with a spectrum of findings including congenital arthrogryposis

checks.claim: AMC9 features include neurodevelopmental abnormalities with failure to reach developmental milestones.
checks.evidence_quote: no achievement of developmental milestones
checks.explanation: The conclusion also points to a role in nervous system development.

checks.claim: AMC9 features include early respiratory failure.
checks.evidence_quote: early respiratory failure
checks.explanation: Early respiratory failure is stated directly.

checks.claim: AMC9 features include immunodeficiency with neutropenia, hypogammaglobulinemia, and recurrent infections.
checks.evidence_quote: early respiratory failure, neutropenia and recurrent infections
checks.explanation: The abstract reports neutropenia and recurrent infections and links SENP7 to immune function. It does not mention hypogammaglobulinemia.

checks.claim: Individuals affected by AMC9 have died in infancy or in utero.
checks.evidence_quote: All died within four months after birth.
checks.explanation: Death in infancy is supported. Death in utero is not mentioned in this paper.

paragraphs.text: In a consanguineous Egyptian family with a lethal prenatal form of AMC9, Saad et al. (2025) used singleton exome sequencing of fetal DNA to identify a homozygous c.745C-T nonsense mutation in the SENP7 gene, resulting in an arg249-to-ter (R249X) substitution. The mutation was predicted to produce a transcript degraded by nonsense-mediated decay, which would impair the isopeptidase activity of SENP7 in deconjugating polySUMO chains.

paragraphs.text: In a kindred with 4 individuals affected by AMC9, Samra et al. (2023) used exome sequencing to identify a homozygous c.1474C-T transition in the SENP7 gene, resulting in a gln492-to-ter (Q492X) substitution. The authors performed segregation studies and considered the mutation the probable cause of the disorder. The affected individuals had congenital arthrogryposis, absent developmental milestones, early respiratory failure, neutropenia, and recurrent infections, and all died within 4 months after birth. Patient fibroblasts showed decreased SENP7 mRNA expression.
